title: Large-workspace OrbStack Linux arm64 excellence boundary
rationale: The proposal preserves direct-manipulation feedback below 150 ms for quick capture, keeps shell/task feedback below one second at p95, and keeps the heavier Library/editor completion paths below 1.25/1.5 seconds at p95. HTTP limits retain roughly 2x or greater observed headroom while still detecting eager full-collection regressions. The 512 MiB RSS, 10 MiB deterministic database, and CPU limits bound the owned 5,000-task/750-document harness without treating one unusually fast sample as the boundary. Values are review material until a human confirms that these limits match the perceived excellence boundary on this reference class.

approval.statement: I approve these thresholds as the Prax reference-hardware excellence boundary.
